title: AI companies are racing to build 'super apps'
excerpt: Silicon Valley has spent years obsessing over "super apps" that can do it all. Google, Microsoft and OpenAI are making moves in that direction.
content_html:
Silicon Valley has spent years obsessing over "super apps" that can do it all. AI is powering a new version of that dream.

Just take Google, which last week did the most Google thing it could: it killed a product.

This wasn't your textbook Google assassination. The company announced it was axing its new AI Studio app — a mobile companion to its AI developer playground — before it even launched, despite 800,000 people having pre-installed it.

The decision came with an explanation: rather than asking users to download yet another app, Google said it wanted to take an approach "where apps emerge naturally, in the course of your everyday conversations with Gemini." In other words, it's going to combine AI Studio into Google's main Gemini app.

Google is just the latest example of a company moving from many products to an app that can do it all. AI is central to this strategy.

Microsoft's 'super app' plan

OpenAI has been talking about this a lot lately. Last month, it launched a new agent that combines its chat and work functions, named ChatGPT Work. It also killed its Atlas browser and said it would migrate some of the functions into the ChatGPT app. Anthropic also recently announced it would merge Claude chat and Cowork.

Microsoft's at it, too. CEO Satya Nadella said on the company's recent earnings call that the company would combine Copilot's function into what he explicitly described as a "super app." (Even Disney reportedly wants in, although not for AI purposes)

China's WeChat, which provides payments, messaging, and social media all in one place, was for a long time the blueprint for Silicon Valley's super app obsession. Elon Musk has talked extensively about his ambitions to turn X into an "everything app" offering a similar spread of services. It recently launched a payments service and has been absorbing features from its AI tool Grok.

PayPal took a swing at building a one-stop shop for payment and commerce in 2021, although it didn't quite pan out. Meta, for a time, took a similar bet on Messenger.

The AI super app era

AI could make the super app dream come true. With AI moving from chatbots to agents capable of performing an increasingly wide range of tasks, such as coding or writing reports, it makes sense to consolidate services in one place. It could also help companies more easily lock users into their ecosystem.

Right now, these apps may not be able to hail a taxi for you or pay your utility bill à la WeChat, but as agents become more capable of working with outside services — and we're able to chat with more apps from within the AI interface — those ideas are increasingly possible.

From a business perspective, building one app to rule them all may require more discipline, particularly for larger companies with more teams and roadmaps to unify. Google is famous for launching multiple and often confusing versions of the same product (a museum of Google's messaging platforms alone would kill half a day), owing to its sprawling and often bureaucratic empire.

As its rivals double down on a more unified experience, Google knows it needs to follow. Logan Kilpatrick, a member of technical staff at Google who leads AI Studio, marked the moment last month in a post on X: "we have now entered the super app era."

content_html_zh:
硅谷多年来一直痴迷于无所不能的“超级应用程序”。 人工智能正在为这个梦想的新版本提供动力。

以谷歌为例，上周它做了谷歌所能做的最多的事情：它杀死了一款产品。

这不是教科书上的谷歌暗杀事件。 该公司宣布，尽管已经有 80 万人预装了新的 AI Studio 应用程序（AI 开发者游乐场的移动伴侣），但该应用程序在推出之前就已被砍掉。

这一决定附带了一个解释：谷歌表示，它希望采取一种“在你与双子座的日常对话过程中自然出现应用程序”的方法，而不是要求用户下载另一个应用程序。 换句话说，它将把 AI Studio 合并到谷歌的主要 Gemini 应用程序中。

谷歌只是公司从多种产品转向全能应用程序的最新例子。 人工智能是这一战略的核心。

微软的“超级应用”计划

OpenAI 最近对此进行了很多讨论。 上个月，它推出了一款结合了聊天和工作功能的新代理，名为 ChatGPT Work。 它还关闭了 Atlas 浏览器，并表示将把部分功能迁移到 ChatGPT 应用程序中。 Anthropic 最近还宣布将合并 Claude chat 和 Cowork。

微软也在做这件事。 首席执行官 Satya Nadella 在公司最近的财报电话会议上表示，公司将把 Copilot 的功能合并到他明确描述的“超级应用程序”中。 （据报道，甚至迪士尼也想加入，尽管不是出于人工智能目的）

中国的微信可以在一个地方提供支付、消息传递和社交媒体服务，长期以来一直是硅谷超级应用痴迷的蓝图。 埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）广泛谈论了他将 X 转变为提供类似服务的“一切应用程序”的雄心。 它最近推出了支付服务，并一直在吸收其人工智能工具 Grok 的功能。

PayPal 在 2021 年尝试建立一站式支付和商务商店，但效果并不理想。 Meta 一度对 Messenger 进行了类似的押注。

AI超级应用时代

人工智能可以让超级应用程序梦想成真。 随着人工智能从聊天机器人转变为能够执行越来越广泛的任务（例如编码或编写报告）的代理，将服务整合到一个地方是有意义的。 它还可以帮助公司更轻松地将用户锁定在其生态系统中。

目前，这些应用程序可能无法像微信那样为您叫出租车或支付水电费，但随着代理与外部服务合作的能力越来越强，而且我们能够通过人工智能界面与更多应用程序聊天，这些想法越来越有可能。

从商业角度来看，构建一个应用程序来统治所有这些可能需要更多的纪律，特别是对于拥有更多团队和统一路线图的大公司来说。 谷歌因推出同一产品的多个且常常令人困惑的版本而闻名（光是谷歌消息平台的博物馆就足以消磨半天的时间），这要归功于其庞大且常常官僚主义的帝国。

随着竞争对手加倍努力提供更统一的体验，谷歌知道它需要效仿。 领导 AI Studio 的 Google 技术人员 Logan Kilpatrick 上个月在 X 上发帖纪念了这一时刻：“我们现在已经进入了超级应用时代。”
